There is no configured Dhenkanal destination connection or route-specific related reading link, and no sustained authored district-language narrative in this template. Separate food/craft/history knowledge is not automatically part of this page. Preserve the useful statistical route; record only its individual exclusion from sustained-article rollout after review.

limits: 2011 district reported mother tongues, not Dhenkanal town alone or current population/fluency/identity.
Groups and subordinate entries overlap by design; never add both as independent people.
C17 statewide multilingual totals are not district evidence.
No new external research, live browser/build tests or fresh source retrieval.
AI research, not human/community review; source facts of separate narratives not independently revalidated.
Only assigned output report written; no canonical/Git/public changes.

If accepted, records-only utility exclusion preserving route/data and separate authored material; no changes to other district classification.
